[[Findlay Prep]] ([[Henderson, Nevada]]) | college = [[Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball|Kansas]] (2014–2015) | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | career_start = | years1 = | team1 = | highlights = *[[McDonald's All-American]] ([[2014 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|2014]]) *[[Parade All-America Boys Basketball Team|''Parade'' All-American]] (2014) }} '''Kelly Paul Oubre, Jr''' (born December 9, 1995) is an American [[basketball]] player at the [[University of Kansas]]. == Early years == Oubre was born in [[New Orleans, Louisiana]] and moved to [[Richmond, Texas]] after [[Hurricane Katrina]] in 2005.[http://www.nola.com/recruiting/index.ssf/2013/05/texas_small_forward_and_new_or.html Texas small forward and New Orleans native Kelly Oubre says LSU in his top 10][http://www.kansas.com/sports/college/big-12/university-of-kansas/article1124915.html KU lands basketball recruit Kelly Oubre] Oubre attended [[George Bush High School]] in [[Fort Bend, Texas]] before transferring to [[Findlay Prep]] in [[Henderson, Nevada]] for his senior season.[http://www.chron.com/neighborhood/fortbend/sports/article/Fort-Bend-Bush-hoopster-Oubre-heading-to-Nebraska-4643100.php Fort Bend Bush hoopster Oubre heading to Nevada] In October 2013 Oubre committed to the [[University of Kansas]] to play [[college basketball]].[http://espn.go.com/college-sports/recruiting/basketball/mens/story/_/id/9792857/kelly-oubre-commits-kansas-jayhawks Kelly Oubre commits to Kansas][http://www.sportingnews.com/ncaa-basketball/story/2013-10-08/report-kelly-oubre-cancels-kentucky-visit-likely-commits-to-kansas-today Kelly Oubre commits to Kansas after nixing Kentucky visit] ==College career== During his freshman season with the [[Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball|Jayhawks]], Oubre was named newcomer of the week twice by the [[Big 12 Conference]]. During the 2014-15 season, Oubre averaged 20.9 minutes, 9.2 points and 5.0 rebounds per game. ==Professional career== ===NBA Draft=== On April 1, 2015, Oubre declared for the [[2015 NBA Draft]].{{cite news |last= |first= |date=January 19, 2015 |title=KU's Kelly Oubre named Big 12 newcomer of the week |url= |newspaper=[[The Topeka Capital-Journal]] |publisher=[[Morris Communications]] |location=[[Topeka, Kansas]] |accessdate=January 20, 2015}} ==References== {{Reflist|30em}} ==External links== *[http://www.kuathletics.com/roster.aspx?rp_id=5850&path=mbball Kansas Jayhawks bio] {{Persondata | NAME = Oubre, Kelly | ALTERNATIVE NAMES = | SHORT DESCRIPTION = basketball player | DATE OF BIRTH = December 9, 1995 | PLACE OF BIRTH = New Orleans, Louisiana | DATE OF DEATH = | PLACE OF DEATH = }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Oubre, Kelly}} [[Category:1995 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:African-American basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Louisiana]] [[Category:Basketball players from Texas]] [[Category:Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball players]] [[Category:McDonald's High School All-Americans]] [[Category:Parade High School All-Americans (boys' basketball)]] [[Category:People from Fort Bend County, Texas]] [[Category:Small forwards]] [[Category:Sportspeople from New Orleans, Louisiana]]
